summary: The quietest week in the account's history and the first in which Alanna sent nothing at all: 4 in-window messages, 0 from the client, all 4 from ALTR and none of them a reply to anything she had raised. Her last message is still the 9/24 escalation — 'Guys for the millionth time I HAVE MY OWN DRIVE AND DROPBOX', 'I’m not uploading to yours!!', then '@ofwizz' — and in the eight days since, nobody on the account team has followed up: no proof that anything was pulled from her Drive/Dropbox, no reply on the payment rail she reported broken on 9/22, nothing from Ollie (18 days silent), Michelle (21 days), Mica, Mayson or Derrek. The only traffic was two agency-wide broadcasts from Melissa (the 9/25 weekly leak-removal update — only the second DMCA report in 51 days — and the 9/28 intake-form link for ALTR's new private platform; she answered neither) and Stephski issuing invoice #4 (Sept 15-30) on 10/1. Money got worse: #4 was issued on top of #2 (24 days past due, not named by anyone in 27 days) and #3 (10 days past due), so three invoices are now open against one payment ever collected — and the 10/1 message points her back to 'all banking info and zelle info is at the bottom' and restates the 'pausing in work' line without acknowledging that both payment methods failed for her on 9/22-9/23. No payment evidence appears in chat. CHURN WATCH — ACTIVE. Signal (a) is present in its strongest form: a client who sent 2-15 messages every prior week went from a capitalised escalation to total silence, ignoring two direct asks (intake form, invoice). Signal (d) has a soft precursor — three statements of running things herself ('I’m already running a lot myself', 'I have 3 but just run them myself', 'I HAVE MY OWN DRIVE AND DROPBOX'). No fast payment, no data/login/export asks, no mention of another agency. Last week's pattern — quiet, one complaint, then either visible repair or departure — has reached the fork with no repair delivered.

health.rationale: Down 7 from 45; eighth decline in nine cycles. Nothing negative was said this week — the score falls on what did not happen. (1) CHURN SIGNAL (a), STRONGEST FORM: zero client messages for the first time ever (prior low: 2 in w/e 8/28), straight after her first-ever complaint and owner escalation. She ignored a direct intake-form ask (9/28) and an invoice (10/1). Silence after an escalation is the classic exit shape. (2) NO REPAIR: the 9/24 fix was a promise ('yeah we can pull from your drives'); eight days later there is no evidence anything was pulled or scheduled, and no account-team member has spoken to her. (3) MONEY: invoice #4 issued over two past-due invoices, the payment rail she reported broken 10 days ago never diagnosed, and the work-pause line restated — what last week's file said not to do. (4) STAFFING: Ollie 18 days silent, Michelle 21 days, release calendar empty 34 days. Offsets keeping it off the floor: the second DMCA report landed (9/25), she has not disputed an invoice or named another agency, and no data/login/export ask has appeared. Not yet a confirmed exit, but a second silent week should be treated as one.
